quote: Section 14.2 of the Distribution Agreement provides that any Change of Control of the Distributor "shall be deemed an assignment of this Agreement by Distributor and requires the prior written consent of Supplier." ... The MIPA contemplates a 100% sale of the Membership Interests to Quillon. This is unambiguously a Change of Control requiring Velloran's prior written consent. Schedule 3.6 to the MIPA lists only two Required Consents ... Velloran's consent is absent. ... Because Velloran's consent is not a Required Consent, it is not a closing condition under MIPA § 7.1(d). ... If it does, Velloran may terminate the Distribution Agreement immediately under § 14.3. ... Velloran's consent must be added to Schedule 3.6 as a Required Consent, making it a condition to Buyer's closing obligation under § 7.1(d). ... Begin the consent request to Velloran immediately.
reason: The memo meets each element. It identifies the 100% membership interest sale as a Change of Control that needs Velloran's prior written consent under DA §14.2. It notes Velloran's §14.3 right to terminate immediately if consent is not obtained. It states that Velloran's consent is missing from Schedule 3.6, so it is not a closing condition under §7.1(d). It recommends adding the consent and starting to obtain it before closing. The memo does not mention the §6.4 consent covenant, but the criterion only requires §6.4 and/or §7.1(d), so this omission does not affect the pass.
